title: Secrets of Strixhaven - Magic: The Gathering with ReRoll Board Games
author: karthikb351
full_content:
A special edition of our weekly Magic: The Gathering meetup featuring a draft of Secrets of Strixhaven.
You can sign up to participate in the draft tournament or just come by to play with other players!
This is a community meetup for Magic: The Gathering, one of the world’s most popular card games. If you are curious about game and don’t know where to start, or are already a player looking to find others to play with in-person, this is for you!
Who are ReRoll Board Games?
We’re a couple of friends who are trying to build a community around tabletop gaming in Bangalore. We’ve been doing this part time for almost 8 years now.
You can follow us on Instagram at @ReRollBLR and join our WhatsApp group .

title: Magic - The Gathering with ReRoll Board Games
excerpt: After years of talking about it, ReRoll is finally starting a Magic: The Gathering meetup! Whether you're curious about this massively popular card game or are already a player looking to find others to play with in person, this is for you!For New Players:This meetup is designed for beginners to explore the game. We’ll teach you the rules and pair new players with each other. We’ll be using 40-card decks from the Jumpstart 2022 set, which offers a fun and simple way to learn the game without spending too much time on deck building.For Experienced Players:We have a selection of premade Standard (60-card) decks and Commander decks available for you to enjoy.This is a light, friendly environment for everyone to explore the game and connect with the community — not a competitive event. Please be helpful and patient, and remember that mistakes are part of the learning process.
